short: The Roman author of the Natural History.
note: Pliny the Elder (23–79 CE), author of the encyclopedic Natural History. Its accounts of distant peoples include the Blemmyae, described as having no heads and faces in their chests.

short: The Venetian traveler whose journeys were recorded in the Travels.
note: Marco Polo, a thirteenth-century Venetian traveler whose account of Asian lands became one of medieval Europe’s most influential travel books.
